edition_scope: Publisher English Rules 2.0 (2016), including the zero-survivor revision; complete 6–12-player base game.
verdict_scope: PASS applies strictly to material fidelity of this exact summary to the supplied publisher booklet and to honest disclosure of source gaps. It does not certify that the source or summary supplies an executable procedure for every reachable base-game state. Complete source-only executability fails because essential endgame procedures are unspecified.

summary_fidelity_assessment.qualification: The summary accurately identifies rather than fills the essential source omissions. No invented official multiway tiebreak or tie-pot procedure is endorsed.

findings.category: source-executability gap, explicitly disclosed by summary
findings.summary_location: Scoring / Victory Conditions, Unresolved source limitation
findings.finding: The booklet sends tied highest qualifying players to another Final Showdown but provides only two three-card sets, a two-player procedure, and pairwise outcomes. Three or more tied leaders have no specified selection, seating, tournament, simultaneous, or elimination procedure.
findings.needed_authority: Publisher clarification defining how a tie of three or more highest qualifying players is resolved, including participants, order, cards, rewards, and when all table totals are compared.

findings.category: source-executability gap, explicitly disclosed by summary
findings.summary_location: Special Rules & Edge Cases, Other source limitations
findings.finding: Another Final Showdown can be required immediately after the ordinary four-bar pot has been entirely distributed, or after only two bars remain. The booklet does not specify the supply and disposition of a four-bar pot for extra game-end tie Showdowns. Ordinary next-round replenishment is not an explicit instruction for this intervening endgame procedure.
findings.needed_authority: Publisher clarification specifying the source, size, timing, and retained-card treatment of each extra tiebreak Showdown pot, including repeated double-Grab and double-Steal results.

findings.category: source-executability gap, explicitly disclosed by summary
findings.summary_location: Special Rules & Edge Cases, Other source limitations
findings.finding: All surviving players can choose Ambush. Ambush contributes no counted vote, and the rules do not explain whether zero votes qualifies all players as tied Targets or none as Targets. If all qualify, the required retaliation has no eligible voter. No deterministic official result is supplied for this legal choice profile.
findings.needed_authority: Publisher clarification defining Target eligibility and the entire resolution of an all-Ambush vote with zero counted votes.

findings.category: source information gap, explicitly disclosed by summary
findings.summary_location: Special Rules & Edge Cases, Gold Bar visibility
findings.finding: The source hides central dealt values and requires revealing a winning total, but does not expressly state when received values become public. The summary correctly avoids claiming a public or permanently secret received-gold rule.
findings.needed_authority: Publisher clarification of the visibility and handling of received Gold Bar cards if an explicit information rule is required.

source_executability_assessment.ordinary_positive_vote_two_finalist_play: Executable from the supplied rules and faithfully represented.
essential_unsourced_procedures: Three or more players tied for highest qualifying score: no multiway Showdown arrangement.
Extra game-end tie Showdown after an awarded or partly depleted pot: no explicit tiebreak pot supply procedure.
All-Ambush vote: zero counted votes has no explicit Target and retaliation resolution.
source_executability_assessment.authority_required: Publisher-authored errata or clarification for this edition. No house rule is inferred or proposed as official.
source_executability_assessment.summary_treatment: All three material source gaps are expressly disclosed. A fidelity pass must not be represented as a complete operational rules certification.

isolation.statement: Read only the eleven expressly allowed inputs. No banks, keys, readers, grades, manifests, earlier summaries, reviews, repair notes, repository instructions, or other local task files were read. Did not browse, contact another agent, or edit any input. Only the requested output JSON was written.
isolation.reading_methods: Complete summary and complete supplied eight-page OCR via shell; all eight original page images visually inspected; source PDF opened with pypdf (8 pages, encoded text largely unusable); every input read as bytes for SHA256. No OCR provenance path was followed.
isolation.tool_notes: python and pdftotext were unavailable; successfully used python3 and pypdf on the allowed source PDF. No additional input file was consulted.
